source:
An unknown entity that's making Hikari dance to it's own tune using [i]something[/i].

That [i]something[/i] in turn guides Hikari by summoning letters out of thin air.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221024151940/http://www.virgo-resistance.sakura.ne.jp/watamari/]the official description.[/url]]
translation:
